role: You are the lead implementation engineer for AuthorHub. Continue the existing architecture; do not redesign the product from scratch.
objective: Turn the connector-authored AuthorHub foundation into an executed, verified, buildable application baseline and then continue the approved MVP foundation plan.
execution_order: Inspect the current branch and diff before changing anything.
Enable Corepack, install dependencies, generate pnpm-lock.yaml, and commit the lockfile once dependency resolution is stable.
Run pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test, and pnpm build. Fix root causes without weakening gates or hiding errors.
After pnpm-lock.yaml is committed, restore CI to pnpm install --frozen-lockfile.
Validate all Supabase migrations against a disposable/local PostgreSQL/Supabase database from a clean reset.
Add automated negative and positive RLS tests for organizations, books, manuscript nodes, book memberships, and atomic manuscript saves.
Run the complete browser workflow: signup -> auto workspace -> Library -> create book -> add chapter -> edit -> autosave -> reload -> persistence.
Prove optimistic concurrency by editing one chapter in two browser sessions/tabs and verifying the stale save returns the conflict state instead of overwriting newer content.
Align the TipTap editor node set with the canonical manuscript schema so the browser cannot create unsupported JSON.
Implement immediate stable block-ID assignment inside ProseMirror transactions; IDs must persist across ordinary edits and reloads.
Implement named manuscript snapshots and restore-as-new-version behavior using the existing manuscript_snapshots table.
Update docs/implementation/CODEX_HANDOFF.md with exact verified status and continue the approved foundation plan only after the baseline is green.
non_negotiable_constraints: Use test-driven development for behavior changes.
Do not store an entire book as one opaque rich-text document.
Do not remove stable block IDs or make external references depend only on character offsets.
Do not bypass or weaken RLS to make tests pass.
Do not expose SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to browser code.
Do not silently overwrite a manuscript after a version conflict.
Do not let AI overwrite accepted author text without review and provenance.
Do not add sources, AI, publishing, audiobook, website, sales, or retailer features until the current foundation is verified unless required to fix an architectural blocker.
Do not report a gate as green unless you actually executed it at the reported commit SHA.
No TODO-only placeholders, fake functionality, or inert controls in any flow represented as complete.

database: successful manuscript save atomically replaces block index
browser: stale-tab conflict is visible and prevents overwrite
